Corresponding sources — third-party components bundled with
TestOrchestrator 2.5.0
=================================================================

All components below are shipped as UNMODIFIED upstream builds
(verbatim wheels/binaries). Corresponding source for each is the
upstream release at the exact version listed.

GPL-2.0 / LGPL-2.1+ components — corresponding source offer
-----------------------------------------------------------------
buildbot          4.3.0    GPL-2.0    https://github.com/buildbot/buildbot  (tag v4.3.0; PyPI: buildbot)
buildbot-worker   4.3.0    GPL-2.0    https://github.com/buildbot/buildbot  (tag v4.3.0; PyPI: buildbot-worker)
buildbot-www      4.3.0    GPL-2.0    https://github.com/buildbot/buildbot  (tag v4.3.0; PyPI: buildbot-www)
paramiko          2.12.0   LGPL-2.1+  https://github.com/paramiko/paramiko  (tag v2.12.0; PyPI: paramiko)

ACCOMPANYING SOURCE: the corresponding source for the components
above is distributed together with the binaries in the archive
TestOrchestrator-Buildbot-Sources-<ver>.tar.gz — beside the
controller package, inside the package at packaging/windows/, and
next to the offline Windows worker installer download in the Admin
UI. The archive contains the exact upstream sdists plus the build
and installation scripts that produce the shipped artifacts.

WRITTEN OFFER: for any copy received without that archive, complete
corresponding machine-readable source for the components above is
available on request from IT-Space Kft. support (the support
contact published with the product) for three (3) years from the
date of delivery, to any third party, at no more than the physical
cost of source distribution. Source is likewise published by the
respective upstream projects at the locations above.

METADATA; wheels marked (pinned) resolve at staging time — amend this
file with resolved versions when 3rdparty/buildbot-wheels/ is staged.

Non-Python bundled assets are covered by 3rdparty/licenses/ and
THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt (git, python-runtime, reporting_labs, etc.).
